concerns.text: The plan lists external dataset URLs but does not provide a dedicated 'Verified datasets' block as required by Constitution Principle II. Without this block the URLs cannot be automatically validated by the Reference‑Validator Agent.
The plan does not contain an explicit Single Source of Truth (SSoT) designation (e.g., a statement linking figures/tables to a unique data row). Constitution Principle I mandates such a designation.

The plan uses a synthetic 8 GB Parquet file generated on‑the‑fly to verify streaming logic (Task T040). This constitutes non‑real‑call testing, which violates Constitution Principle V that forbids synthetic data for functional verification.
